title: What Happens When 4 Teens Steal a Jaguar and Livestream It on Facebook
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 4, 2022, police identified a stolen black Jaguar being driven recklessly in Racine, WI. Further investigation revealed that the car was occupied by four teenagers, identified as gang members with a history of carrying firearms. Police also learned the driver had live-streamed a video from the Jaguar on the day it was stolen. During a pursuit, the vehicle collided with two other cars and all four teens fled on foot.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
